transcript.content: Gallery 中「显示页面图标」及「属性是否可见 → Title」配置未生效 > 若为「如何使用 / 部署咨询」而非可复现缺陷，请改用 [Discussions · 使用问答](https://github.com/notionnext-org/NotionNext/discussions/new/choose)，Issue 仅用于可跟踪的 Bug。 --- **描述bug** 首先感谢作者以及各位维护者一直以来对项目的维护与更新！ 这是 #4293 修复后的回归测试结果。 由于我没有权限重新打开原 Issue，所以单独提交一个新的 Issue 继续反馈。 我更新到最新 main 后重新部署进行了测试，目前这个问题似乎仍然存在。 另外，在继续测试过程中，我发现了一个新的现象，感觉可能与这个问题有关。 我分别测试了下面两种配置： 情况一 * 显示页面图标：关闭 * 属性是否可见：Title 设置为不可见 Notion 中显示符合配置，但网站端仍然显示页面图标和 Title。 情况二 * 显示页面图标：关闭 * 属性是否可见：Title 设置为可见 Notion 中显示同样符合配置，但网站端依然显示页面图标。 我已经更新到最新 main 并重新部署，多次刷新页面测试，结果一致。 不确定这两个现象是否属于同一个问题，所以一起反馈，希望对定位有所帮助。 **期望的正常结果** Gallery 应与 Notion 配置保持一致。 * 当关闭 显示页面图标 时，网站端不再显示页面图标； * 当 属性是否可见 中将 Title 设置为不可见时，网站端不显示 Title。 **复现步骤** 1. 更新到最新 main 并重新部署； 2. 打开一个 Gallery 页面； 3. 测试以下两种配置： * 显示页面图标：关闭；Title：不可见； * 显示页面图标：关闭；Title：可见； 4. 刷新页面查看网站端显示结果。 **环境** - 【必填】NotionNext版本 [例如. 4.10.8] - 【必填】主题 [hexo] - 【必填】部署方案 [vercel] - 【可选】操作系统: [iOS, Android, windows] - 【可选】浏览器 [chrome, safari, firefox] **补充说明** 【可选】与问题相关的其它说明 The repository is at /testbed.

The git log has no commit that mentions #4293; it holds only a 'baseline' commit and unrelated ones.","findings":["patches/react-notion-x+7.10.0.patch:~12 patches node_modules/react-notion-x/build/third-party/collection.js. The Gallery wrapper className now adds 'notion-gallery-hide-page-icons' when collectionView.format.show_page_icon === false.","styles/notion.css:2202 has `.notion-gallery-hide-page-icons .notion-page-title-icon { display:none; }`, preceded by the comment 'Respect Notion Gallery's Show page icon view setting'.","__tests__/components/NotionCollectionGallery.test.js renders a gallery with show_page_icon true/false and expects the hide class only when false. Its fixture uses gallery_properties: [] and gallery_cover {type:'none'}.","The Title bug is in the library's CollectionCard (node_modules/react-notion-x/build/third-party/collection.js:~5425-5580). This could be another patch to react-notion-x, or CSS or a class on the gallery.","components/NotionPage.js only has gallery click handling: POST_DISABLE_GALLERY_CLICK at line 20, and processGalleryImg at lines 163 and 43. The patch doesn't change CollectionCard. Gallery-card icons are normally rendered by PageTitle's PageIcon, which has that class, so the CSS should hide them. I haven't run this in a browser, so I can't say for certain why the icon still shows. content.text:
I changed the Gallery patch and CSS so both settings should now be respected. I haven't built or tested any of it, and I haven't re-run `patch-package` or the existing Gallery test.

- **Page icon:** the patch already added `notion-gallery-hide-page-icons` when `show_page_icon === false`. It now also adds the class when `gallery_show_page_icon === false`. I don't know which key Notion actually writes, so I check both.
- **Title:** the library never read the Title entry in `gallery_properties`. The patch now adds `notion-gallery-hide-titles` to the Gallery when that entry has `visible: false`. A new rule in `styles/notion.css` hides the first property in each card body, which is the title.

Two things to check before relying on this:
- **Patch not applied:** the helper found that the installed `node_modules/react-notion-x/build/third-party/collection.js` doesn't contain the existing patch. That alone could explain why the icon still shows after deploying. The patch needs to be applied (`patch-package`, normally run on install) and `.next` rebuilt.
- **Hunk line count:** I edited the patch file by hand and changed its hunk header from 10 to 11 new lines. If it fails to apply, check that count first.

I didn't add tests for the Title case.
